component.name: Wayterm
component.summary: An open source, multi-protocol connection manager and terminal for Linux

description.p: An open source, multi-protocol connection manager and terminal for Linux, in the spirit of MobaXterm but built for a desktop that already has the tools: saved sessions in a tree, tabbed SSH terminals with an SFTP sidebar, local shell and serial tabs, embedded RDP and VNC tabs, and configurable hotkeys.
First packaged release; see GitHub for details.
